name: Makai Tenshi Djibril -Episode 2-
source:
Otonashi Meimi is walking alone in an empty park when the demon Rococo suddenly appears. Rococo users her Eternal Worm attack on Meimi in order to separate the power of Misty Mei from within her body.
Meanwhile, at Naoto's house, Hikari, Naoto's stepsister who was studying abroad, returns home. She starts going to the same school as Naoto, and it worries Rika, Naoto's lover, a little.
"I love you the most in the world." - With these words, Naoto makes love with Rika in the school's nurse's office. However, Misty Mei appears and spirits Rika away. Then, the angel Loveriel appears saying that Naoto has no choice but to have sex with Hikari so that a new Djibril can be born to save Rika.

[From [url=http://www.animenfo.com/animetitle,4048,gnuqbq,makai_tenshi_ji.html]AnimeNFO[/url]]
translation:
音无美美独自走在空荡荡的公园里，恶魔可可突然出现。可可对她使用了永虫攻击，目的是将Misty Mei的力量从她体内分离出来。
与此同时，直人的家中，他出国留学的义妹光回来了。她开始和直人上同一所学校，这让直人的恋人理香有些担心。"我最爱你了。"——说完这句话，直人和理香在学校的保健室里做爱了。然而，Misty Mei出现并将理香掳走。随后，天使Loveriel出现，告诉直人他别无选择，只能与光发生关系，让新的加布里耶诞生，以拯救理香。

[来自[url=http://www.animenfo.com/animetitle,4048,gnuqbq,makai_tenshi_ji.html]AnimeNFO[/url]]
